30mg\/dl.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPt came to the surgery department with c\/o multiple ulcers over lt leg since 6 months.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPt was apparently asymptomatic 6 months back then he developed 4 small ulcers of size 1x 1 cm initially, which was gradually increasing to attain present size.H\/o fever which was on and off. Then he suddenly developed Hypoglycemic symptoms and became unconscious\u0026nbsp; and transferred to medicine department.No H\/o trauma\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o Fracture at left elbow joint which was ill treated - Non union of Fracture 30 yrs back.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPt is a K\/C\/O of DM and is on regular medication - T. Glimestarmil PO\/OD\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHad H\/o pulmonary cox 2 yrs ago.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EN\/K\/C\/O HTN,Asthma,Epilepsy.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr
